title: Unit Event — A Sad Farewell at the Curtain Call — Episode1 No More Ambassadorial Show?!

meta.Event: A Sad Farewell at the Curtain Call
meta.Event Outline: The next ambassadorial performance is going to be the last one?! Wonderlands×Showtime is staggered to hear the news, but is followed by an offer to do a joint performance with a highly regarded theme park that puts on the best shows in Japan. As chaotic practices ensue, Rui is approached by a certain person...

rows.Line: Rui's Room

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Okay, it's complete.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Hehe. We'll be able to use this miniature lighting mechanism to do projection mapping wherever we like, which should allow us to employ a wide variety of new effects.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (I'm looking forward to seeing how everyone reacts when they see this.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Ah, if only it could be tomorrow now. Then I'd be able to show them immediately.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (I have them to thank for being able to try putting on so many different kinds of shows.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: If we can keep putting on shows like this for as long as possible...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Y-Yes, we probably will have to go our separate ways in order to pursue our dreams...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: The thought of that happening is really sad and makes my heart sink...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
But when that happens...
I have a feeling that it'll be the moment when we take a big step towards achieving our goals...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Nene...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: And until that time comes, I want to cherish the shows that we're able to do together...!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: All of us... Together!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Until that time comes, eh...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
She's right though.
We'll have to cross that bridge eventually.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: So, until then, I should keep doing my absolute best.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Anyway, I should go to bed soon. They'll surely scold me if I show up with bags under my eyes...
The next day
Wonder Stage

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Hmm...
Soon... No, not yet... But they should be...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: We're done cleaning over here!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Good job, you two.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Hm...?
What's Tsukasa doing over there? He seems kinda anxious.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, he does. He seemed fine just a second ago...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Ah, it may be because Emu's brothers are supposed to meet with us soon...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Oh, right.
They usually tell us where we're going to do our ambassadorial performances in the morning on days off.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah, I can't wait to hear about where we're going next♪

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Hmm... They should be here soon...
But they're later than usual...

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line:
Good morning.
You all seem well, as usual.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Ah, there you are!

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line:
Whoa!
What's going on? There's no need to run...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I've been eagerly waiting to hear about where we'll be doing our next ambassadorial performance! Our show for Shibuya Festa went beyond splendidly, so I'm looking forward to producing similar results!

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line:
Ah, I see...
Well...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Hm?
Is something wrong, Shosuke?

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line:
Um, so...
Shouldn't we tell them already, Keisuke...?

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line:
Yes.
It'll make things easier to explain if we start with that.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: What's going on?

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: The thing is...

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: Your next ambassadorial performance will be your last.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: What?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Wh-What do you mean?!
This is so sudden! Why?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yeah! Why?!
Everyone loves our shows and they always smile after seeing them! What's going on here?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Mind if we ask for more details regarding this?

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: Yes, of course.

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line:
First...
It will be your last, but that is not actually a bad thing.

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: Remember what our initial objective was... To attract guests from other parts of the country who don't normally get a chance to visit our park.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, I do remember you guys mentioning how this park is easy to access for the locals but not for people who live far away...

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line:
Precisely.
Our main goal was to attract guests from the more far-flung regions of the country...

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: However, we ended up accomplishing that goal much quicker than we initially expected. As a result, we've seen a high influx of those guests.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
So, our shows really worked...?!
Woohoo! Awesome!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Ah, which is why we won't be doing any more shows!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: At the same time...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: If they were so effective, why not keep doing them...?

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: Point taken, but as it so happens, quite a few of our guests visit Phoenix Wonderland to specifically see your shows. More than you might expect.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I see. Now I'm starting to understand...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: They're visiting the park to see us perform, so not being here because of our ambassadorial duties would only serve to disappoint them...

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line:
Yes, exactly.
As such, we need you to stay and perform at the Wonder Stage.

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: Then, both the park and its guests will benefit.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Right...
I guess that makes sense if they want to see us that much...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Yes, we should be grateful.
Still...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: We learned so much from doing these performances. In that sense, this is rather unfortunate news...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yeah...
You, Nene and Rui smiled so much... And I learned a lot...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: But I'm also happy that so many people from all over the country are coming to visit!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Hehe. Me too.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, these ambassadorial performances were definitely worth the effort, since we needed to come up with so many creative solutions for them.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
I agree...!
And we'll do the same for everyone who comes to see us at the Wonder Stage by putting on magnificent shows for them!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: But first, we'll need to cap off our ambassadorial performances with a big finale!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yeah!!
Let's do our best to make that happen!!

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: We actually have a suggestion regarding your final ambassadorial performance.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: A suggestion?

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line:
Yes.
This may feel a bit sudden, but...

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: How would you all like to do a show with the cast of ArcLand...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hm? ArcLand...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: As in Tokyo ArcLand?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
What?! The ArcLand...?!
The park that's famous for putting on world-class shows and performances...?!

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: Yes, the very same. Not unlike Riley Dream Park, they operate parks in ten countries around the world that are based on the countless movies they've produced.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: That's a very attractive offer, but how did this come to be exactly...?

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: Not too long ago, some people from ArcLand contacted us about our show casts doing a performance together as a sort of cultural exchange meant to help raise each other's skills.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: A cultural exchange?

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: We wondered why they were asking us this at all initially, and believed that they were trying to undermine us somehow after we finalized our partnership with Riley Dream Park...

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: However, as it turns out, they genuinely seem to want to use this opportunity to give their cast members a chance to improve their skills.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Really? Even though they're already this popular...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Despite being the best show in town, they're not resting on their laurels. That's very admirable of them...

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: They even mentioned you specifically and how it'd be an honor to work with the peerless casts of the Wonder Stage and Phoenix Stage since they're all the rage right now.

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: We're thinking about having Seiryuin and her troupe guide them around the park, with you all doing a show with them. How does that sound...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (ArcLand is the theme park that arguably puts on the best shows in the country.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (They've even put on shows recently with casts consisting of some of the best young actors around and directors from around the world. They're clearly not afraid to take on new challenges.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (We stand to learn a lot from them. This could be an opportunity for us to grow quite a bit as a troupe.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (And I'm personally curious...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
I'd like to go forward with this.
What do you all think?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
I'm for it too!
If lots and lots of people come to see our show, it's gonna be even more wonderhoy than usual!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I might start feeling nervous if too many people show up... At the same time, I could learn a lot from this experience. So, I'm also for it...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Excellent!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
I have no complaints!
Let us take this opportunity as those who truly love shows to learn as much as we can from one another!

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line:
Ah, wonderful.
Then, we'll let them know right away.

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: We feel bad about dumping this on you so suddenly, but do your best during your last ambassadorial performance, okay?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Still, how many people do you think are gonna come? I really don't feel great about performing with a whole load of new people...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Nonsense! You're going to be a world-famous songstress! You should have more confidence in yourself!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yeah, he's right!
You're gonna knock their socks off!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Just by being confident?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Speaking of which, where will we be performing exactly?

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: At the Museum of Emerging Technologies that's about to have its grand opening. Here's a pamphlet for it.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: That means we'll also be advertising the museum itself! We'll need to do our best for this!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Wow...!
This place looks so cool! And shiny!

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: This museum seems to focus on the near future and has exhibits that introduce state-of-the-art technologies from around the world. The plaza outside will be your stage.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: The near future...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm already getting some interesting ideas.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: In any case, let's all do our best to put on the best show we can together.
